answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 3707 Country: India Title: I saw one dream four months ago at 9:00 AM in the morning that two men came me and asked that I am going to die very soon, during that time i was pragnent, please inform me about the TAABEER of this dream. in urdu and english, it will be highly obliged if you do the needful. Question: I saw one dream four months ago at 9:00 AM in the morning that two men came me and asked that I am going to die very soon, during that time i was pragnent, please inform me about the TAABEER of this dream. in urdu and english, it will be highly obliged if you do the needful. Answer ID: 3707 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 104/72=) There is a warning in the dream that life of the world though a bit long it may be, but the time of death is very near compared to the life hereafter. Therefore, you should be concerned about the life after death so that you gain Allah's pleasure. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
